Reviewer: MacBook-Pro.local pool job review-4195 (config `~/.claude-bob`), claude-opus-5-5, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.** The PR also conflicts with `main`.

Thank you for this PR. The three items of #4148 are present, and each pinning test fails when its fix is removed. But one golden suite of `camcraft-app` is red with this PR and green on `main`. Please see the requested changes below.

This is a safety-tier review: the PR changes posted G-code (the Mach3 header line and the Mach3 N words).

## What looks good

- Mach3: `sequenceNumberStart` is now `max: 99999`. `nextSeq()` refuses N above 99999 with one counted `msg()`. In the app a counted warning blocks the write, so the refusal is visible.
- Mach3: the header line now writes `G64`. The program does not use the path mode that the control had before.
- Mach4: a smoothing request now gives one note per program, the same pattern as Mach3 (`smoothOn()` / `smoothOff()`).
- No `unwrap()` / `panic!` outside tests. No change to project files, commands or UI.

## Results (locally, trial merge with upstream/main `fa813d5df`)

The trial merge has one conflict: `crates/post/tests/mach4_post.rs`. Main added `mach4_zero_dwell_backbore_posts_g85` at the same place. For this review only, I kept the two tests. I did not push this merge.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post --tests` (143 test binaries, includes `mach3_post`, `mach4_post`, `script_mach3`, `script_mach4`, `recorded`, `wcs_flip`, `wcs_flip_dialects`) | pass, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test conformance` | **FAIL**: 5 passed, 2 failed |
| same `conformance` step with `assets/posts/mach3.cps` of `main` (bare main post) | pass, 7 passed |
| app suites of the quick plan: `after_op`, `bore_cycle`, `catalog_groove_part_off`, `continuous_4axis_part`, `control_comp`, `first_4axis_part`, `first_part_programs`, `first_router_part`, `inverted_axis_display`, `mach4_builtin`, `post_cycle_feed_spindle`, `post_spindle_rule_all`, `probe_no_coolant`, `program_comments`, `program_info`, `program_units`, `tilt_basis_compat`, `wear_comp` | pass, 0 failed |
| `example_catalog` (43), `example_catalog_adaptive` (1), `example_catalog_edge_work` (1) | pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Conformance failure text:

```
thread 'every_builtin_posts_every_golden_byte_exact' panicked at crates/app/tests/conformance.rs:240:13:
Mach3: crates/app/tests/golden/nc/mach3/contour_disc_hole.nc is stale; regenerate with WRITE_GOLDEN=1
  left:  "(VMC 3-AXIS)\nG21 G17 G90 G91.1 G94 G40 G49 G80 G64\n..."
  right: "(VMC 3-AXIS)\nG21 G17 G90 G91.1 G94 G40 G49 G80\n..."

thread 'the_synthesized_stream_locks_the_tool_and_spindle_words' panicked at crates/app/tests/conformance.rs:409:9:
Mach3: crates/app/tests/golden/nc/synth_mach3.nc is stale; regenerate with WRITE_GOLDEN=1
```

Extra suites run: none were owed. The diff does not touch `testdata/` or the import code. The post goldens that moved are read by `recorded` and `wcs_flip` of `camcraft-post`, and both pass.

Heavy lanes: not run. This is a `P7` PR, and AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" gives it no heavy step.

## Mutations (run by the reviewer)

| Mutation | Pinning test | Result |
|---|---|---|
| remove `"G64"` from the Mach3 header `block()` | `mach3_header_writes_g64_path_mode` | red |
| `if (seqNum < 1 \|\| seqNum > 99999)` changed to `if (false)` | `mach3_sequence_numbers_cap_and_refuse_over_99999` | red |
| remove the `smoothOn()` call from Mach4 `startPreamble()` | `mach4_smoothing_request_emits_operator_notification_comment` | red |

## Goldens moved (checked line by line)

The 7 `.nc` files in the PR change only line 2: `G64` is added at the end of the modal header line. No other line changes:

- `crates/post/tests/golden/wcs_flip/mach3_x.nc`
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/mach3/{arcs,drill_retract,empty_section,extreme_coords,full_circle,full_circle_raw}.nc`

This change agrees with item 2 of #4148.

## Requested before merge

1. **The Mach3 goldens of `camcraft-app` did not move (blocker, red suite).** `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/synth_mach3.nc` and each file in `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/mach3/` still have the old header line. `conformance` fails, and it passes on `main`. Run `WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p camcraft-app --test conformance`. Then check that each changed file has only the `G64` change on line 2, and commit them. Also search all directories for Mach3 programs with the old header line, so that one rule closes the class: `grep -rlE "G91\.1 G94 G40 G49 G80\s*$" --include="*.nc" crates examples`. Only the Tormach and LinuxCNC files must stay as they are.
2. **The PR body has no "Goldens moved" list (blocker).** A recorded program (`*.nc`) that changes must be listed in the body. Add a "Goldens moved" section with each moved `.nc` file (the 7 files above and the app goldens of item 1), and the reason: "header line adds `G64`, #4148 item 2".
3. **The Mach4 note names the wrong control** (`assets/posts/mach4.cps:504`). A Mach4 program now says `(SMOOTHING NOT WRITTEN - MACH3 G64 HAS NO TOLERANCE)`. This is a misleading message for a Mach4 operator. Write `MACH4` in the Mach4 post, and change the expected text in `mach4_smoothing_request_emits_operator_notification_comment` (`crates/post/tests/mach4_post.rs`) to the same text. The test message "matching Mach3" can then say "the same pattern as Mach3".
4. **A new top-level test file needs a reason** (AGENTS.md "New tests join a directory suite", #3187). `crates/post/tests/mach3_post.rs` is a new test binary, and the body gives no reason. Please move its two tests into the existing `crates/post/tests/script_mach3.rs` (or `mach4_post.rs` shows the same pattern for Mach4). Alternatively, add a one-line reason to the PR body.
5. **Conflict with `main`** in `crates/post/tests/mach4_post.rs`. Merge `origin/main` into the branch (do not rebase). Keep the two tests: main's `mach4_zero_dwell_backbore_posts_g85` and your `mach4_smoothing_request_emits_operator_notification_comment`.

## Notes (not blocking)

- After the first refusal, Mach3 writes the remaining blocks with no N word. This is acceptable, because the counted warning blocks the write in the app.
- `crates/post/tests/mach4_post.rs` ends with an extra empty line after the new test.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addresses review feedback from @mkinney:

1. Merged main into the branch. Kept both mach4_zero_dwell_backbore_posts_g85 and mach4_smoothing_request_emits_operator_notification_comment in crates/post/tests/mach4_post.rs.
2. Changed MACH3 to MACH4 in the Mach4 smoothing notification comment (^Gssets/posts/mach4.cps:504). Updated the test assertion in crates/post/tests/mach4_post.rs.
3. Regenerated the Mach3 conformance goldens for camcraft-app. Checked that only line 2 (G64 added to modal header block) changed in all 13 files. Confirmed that no other Mach3 programs lack G64.
4. Added gate map and provenance headers to crates/post/tests/mach3_post.rs. Added the test binary reason to the pull request description.
5. Added the 'Goldens moved' section with all 20 updated .nc files to the pull request description.

Checks run:
- cargo test -p camcraft-post (clean, 0 failures)
- cargo test -p camcraft-app --test conformance (clean, 7 passed)
- cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings (clean)
